instruction: Install the extension located in the helloExtension directory on your Desktop into Google Chrome as a development extension.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Slightly different wording ('Load the development extension'). Reuses original evaluator logic checking path. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts all loaded extension paths from Chrome Preferences file
Metric logic correctly checks if expected path is present in the list of loaded extensions
Expected value is semantically correct - matches the instruction requirement to load extension from /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension
Data flow is correct: getter returns list of paths, metric checks membership, expected value specifies the target path
Complete coverage of instruction requirement - verifies extension path is registered in Chrome
Minor limitation: only checks path registration in Preferences, not actual extension functionality or enabled state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider additional validation that extension is enabled, not just registered in Preferences
Could add path normalization to handle trailing slashes or symlinks robustly
